,CUST_MADDR2

,CUST_PHONE_AREA
,CUST_MOBILE_CTY

,CUST_OFFICE_CTY
,CUST_OFFICE_AREA
,CUST_TITLE
,CUST_DATE_MAINT
,LEFT(CUST_BNK_CODE,5) AS BNK_CODE
,CUST_SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
,NULL AS TABLE_NAME
,CUST_FILE_NAME AS FILE_NAME
,CUST_insert_dttm AS insert_dttm
,CUST_SCD_START_DATE
,CUST_SCD_END_DATE
,AS_OF_DATE
FROM EDS.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT CCF
WHERE   --CCF.CUST_SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31' AND 
    COALESCE(CUST_LOCAL_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CUST_FIRST_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CUST_LAST_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,'') NOT LIKE 'TES%'
    AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,'') NOT LIKE 'TST%'
    AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,'') NOT LIKE 'XXX%';
GO

ALTER VIEW [EDS].[SYN_CORE_ACCTAUTHSIGN_VW] AS SELECT
 ACID
,BANK_ID
,CUST_ID
,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
,DEL_FLG
,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,insert_dttm
,AS_OF_DATE
FROM
(
SELECT
AAS.ACID
,AAS.BANK_ID
,AAS.CUST_ID
,AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,AAS.ENTITY_CRE_FLG
,AAS.DEL_FLG
,AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
,AAS.BNK_CODE BNK_CODE
,'CORE' SOURCE_CODE
,AAS.insert_dttm
,AAS.AS_OF_DATE
FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP AAS
INNER JOIN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE) B ON AAS.AS_OF_DATE = B.AS_OF_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT 
AAS.ACID
,AAS.BANK_ID
,AAS.CUST_ID
,AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,AAS.ENTITY_CRE_FLG
,AAS.DEL_FLG
,AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
,AAS.BNK_CODE BNK_CODE
,'CORE' SOURCE_CODE
,AAS.insert_dttm
,AAS.AS_OF_DATE
FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN AAS
INNER JOIN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE) B ON AAS.AS_OF_DATE = B.AS_OF_DATE
) A;
GO


ALTER VIEW [EDS].[SYN_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_VW] AS SELECT
ACID
,BANK_ID
,FORACID
,ACCT_NAME
,ACCT_SHORT_NAME
,NAT_LANG_TITLE_CODE
,NATIVE_LANG_NAME
,CUST_ID
,CIF_ID
,ACCT_OPN_DATE
,ACCT_CLS_DATE
,ACCT_CLS_FLG
,LAST6_ACC_NUM
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,insert_dttm
,AS_OF_DATE
FROM
(
SELECT 
DF.GAM_ACID AS ACID
,DF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
,DF.FORACID
,DF.ACCT_NAME
,DF.ACCT_SHORT_NAME
,DF.NAT_LANG_TITLE_CODE
,DF.NATIVE_LANG_NAME
,DF.CUST_ID
,DF.CIF_ID
,DF.ACCT_OPN_DATE
,DF.ACCT_CLS_DATE
,DF.ACCT_CLS_FLG
,DF.GAM_LAST6_ACC_NUM AS LAST6_ACC_NUM
,DF.GAM_BNK_CODE AS BNK_CODE
,'CORE' AS SOURCE_CODE
,DF.GAM_insert_dttm AS insert_dttm
,DF.AS_OF_DATE
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DF
INNER JOIN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.LOAN_FACT GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE) B ON DF.AS_OF_DATE = B.AS_OF_DATE
UNION ALL 
SELECT 
LF.GAM_ACID AS ACID
,LF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
,LF.FORACID
,LF.ACCT_NAME
,LF.ACCT_SHORT_NAME
,LF.NAT_LANG_TITLE_CODE
,LF.NATIVE_LANG_NAME
,LF.CUST_ID
,LF.CIF_ID
,LF.ACCT_OPN_DATE
,LF.ACCT_CLS_DATE
,LF.ACCT_CLS_FLG
,LF.GAM_LAST6_ACC_NUM AS LAST6_ACC_NUM
,LF.GAM_BNK_CODE AS BNK_CODE
,'CORE' AS SOURCE_CODE
,LF.GAM_insert_dttm AS insert_dttm
,LF.AS_OF_DATE
FROM EDS.LOAN_FACT LF
INNER JOIN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE) B ON LF.AS_OF_DATE = B.AS_OF_DATE
) A;
GO
